awk -F'\t' '{print $1 "\t" $2}' temp_var_inventory/raw_listing.txt | while IFS=$'\t' read -r path type; do

      readlink -f -- "$tgt" 2>/dev/null || printf '%s\n' "$tgt"
    fi
  fi
done | sort -u > temp_var_inventory/file_list.txt
wc -l < temp_var_inventory/file_list.txt
